_about: Toru Dutt's Ancient Ballads and Legends of Hindustan (this printing 1885), nine ballads retelling Indian legends (Savitri, Lakshman, Prehlad, Sita and others) and seven miscellaneous poems, with Edmund Gosse's memoir. Gutenberg catalogue: Toru Dutt 1856-1877, Gosse 1849-1928. Not to be confused with Romesh Chunder Dutt on the dutt shelf.
